props.caption: A prototype enters the funnel at TRL 4; field evidence decides whether it leaves with a grant.

items.note: Spain’s low evening Sun left the totality path dependent on a clear western horizon.
BraveTech EU opened a TRL 4+ route from application to field trial for autonomous strike and swarm systems.
A$31.30 applies to engaged delivery hours from 17 August; the clock starts after acceptance.
ANPD told Discord to suspend Go Live inside closed servers while it examines child-safety risk.
Ash restrictions kept moving through the airport’s evening updates and into Mediterranean diversions.
India and SACU signed terms for negotiating a preference pact; the document moved no tariff.

items.what: More than half of women interviewed by UN Women said they leave home no more than twice a month; nearly three-quarters felt unsafe outside without a male guardian. The figures combine a 2025 door-to-door survey with 2026 telephone interviews and should be read as two samples.

items.kicker: India Opens the SACU Bargaining Book
items.what: India and the five-state Southern African Customs Union signed terms of reference for a preferential-trade negotiation across eight areas. The document opens bargaining on tariffs and rules of origin; it cuts no tariff today.

items.kicker: Etna Keeps Moving the Airport Clock
items.what: Etna’s ash kept Catania Airport extending airspace restrictions through the evening, pushing diversions toward Palermo and ripples into Malta. Each update defined the next operating window while plume movement governed the reopening.

items.kicker: Shelter Carries the Soft CPI Month
items.what: U.S. consumer prices rose 0.1% in July and 3.4% over the year, while core inflation printed 2.5%. Shelter supplied about two-thirds of the monthly increase, keeping one soft monthly headline attached to a sticky category.

items.kicker: The Chawingas Take Malawi to the Final
items.what: Tabitha Chawinga scored twice and Temwa Chawinga once as Malawi beat Algeria 3–1 and reached its first Women’s Africa Cup of Nations final. The sisters converted professional careers abroad into a national breakthrough in Rabat.

items.kicker: ISRO Counts Six Hundred Booster Signals
items.what: ISRO qualified a revised SSLV first-stage booster after measuring more than 600 parameters in a full-scale static firing. The lighter, more manufacturable design is expected to add about 100 kilograms to low-Earth-orbit payload; flight still has to prove the gain.

items.kicker: CrewAI Gives an Aborted Flow a Start
items.what: CrewAI 1.15.15 now emits a start event even when a boundary hook aborts a flow and adds outcome, duration and human-intervention signals. The release improves the audit trail around stopped agents; it does not create a complete permissions system.

items.kicker: Seoul Pulls the Moon Two Years Closer
items.what: South Korea grouped seven strategic technology areas under its SEED programme and moved its stated Moon-landing target to 2030. The targets reach across quantum, fusion, small reactors, space and critical materials; supporting procurement schedules remain unpublished.
